September at Coro looked like messy hands, curious minds, long lunches, new faces, old friends and a lot of PLAY.

From networking events to strenght training, workshops, conversations, coffee breaks and everything in between, here’s a little look at the month that was.

See you in October 🍂💫
Different roles, one community, that’s the Coro magic ✨

Co-working by day, chaos-and-craft-central by playtime, coffee shop energy all the time! 

Coro is basically three of your favorite places rolled into one. And behind all of it? A crew that shows up to make it feel like home. ☕💻🎨

Work, Play, Experience at Coro, see you!

Somewhere between the messy hands, tiny rhythms, curious minds and “one more time!” is where so much learning happens. 🌱✨

Meet Akanksha, the person behind Sensory Safari and Music Together, where toddlers get to explore, experiment, move, listen, share and discover alongside their grown-ups.

Come curious. Stay for the play. 🐾🎶

DM us to reserve a spot!

One thing we really, really love? Books. Picture books, story books, chapter books, fiction books, non-fiction books, thick books and novellas, short stories and graphic novels, we love them all.

On Sundays, grab a book from our selection or bring your own, find a nook, get a coffee and rediscover your love for reading.

Books by champacabooks. Coffee and snacks by plume.delicacies. Corners by Coro.

Little moments make big childhood memories. 🐘🤍
because childhood magic is play! 

At the playscape, explore culture, create, connect and share these joys for growing up with your child ✨

We’re here, doing work we genuinely care about. ✨

A space where ideas get exchanged, work gets done, people find their people and where the next generation gets to be part of the picture too.

There’s something pretty special about working in a place that makes room for both big ideas and little voices 🤍

What are we thinking about at Coro? A lot, actually.

Parenting. Design. Work. Balance. Community. The way we live, and the way we work.

Our new Substack is where we’re putting some of those thoughts down, alongside stories and perspectives from the people who make up Coro.

Come over. There’s plenty to talk about.
Link in bio to subscribe!

Three very good reasons to hang out with us: the food, the vibe and the coffee. 

Every day 9am-9pm ☕️

A little bit of work, a little bit of creativity, a chance to move your body and a whole lot of play- this is what a weekend at Coro looks like. 

A place where you can bring the whole family, dip in and out of the things that interest you, meet new people, make something with your hands, get a workout in, or simply spend grab a looong, slow coffee together.

Weekends should feel less like a list of things to get done and more like a place to be.

Make Coro part of your weekend and come spend the day with us!

You must have noticed how packed our calendar is. That is not by accident. We knew from the moment we set out to build Coro we wanted more than a space, we wanted a living, lively ecosystem.

Our programming is designed to create opportunities to meet, discover something new and spend time with people you might not otherwise cross paths with.

The best communities aren’t built by chance, they’re built through shared experiences, familiar faces and plenty of reasons to come back.

Come to an event. Bring your people. Meet some new ones.

Follow along and DM us to find out what’s coming up at Coro!

What if your coworking space was actually designed around your life, and not just your laptop?

At Coro, work is just one part of the picture. You have beautifully designed spaces to focus and meet, great coffee to carry you through the day, a community of interesting people around you, and something you won’t find in a traditional coworking space: on-site childcare.

The best workday is one where you don’t have to choose between getting things done and everything else that matters.

Work. Childcare. Community. Design. All under one roof.

Come see what working at Coro feels like.

DM us to book a tour or enquire about memberships.

Our goal with Coro’s Playscape has always been to create a “yes space” for children: a space where they get to choose their own adventure, their activity and their own pace.

We want children (and parents!) to discover just how capable they are, while building confidence and independence along the way. From a sink that’s at their eye level to practising how to order for themselves, we love seeing that independence come to life.

And this is exactly why Cafe Plume is the ideal Playscape partner for us: they just get kids.

If you’re looking for a space where your child can explore, make choices and do things for themselves, come experience Coro Playscape.

Come play, explore and say YES to independence. Walk in and join us! 💜

There are days when you don’t need another class, another outing, or another carefully planned activity.

You just need somewhere your child can go, play, move, explore and be.

That’s the idea behind Coro Playscape, a dedicated space designed around the way children naturally learn: through movement, curiosity, imagination, sensory play and, most importantly, play for the sake of play.

For them, it’s freedom to choose what they want to do and follow their own curiosity.
For you, it’s one less thing to organise, plan or entertain.

So the next time you hear, “What are we doing today?”, we have an answer.

Coro Playscape. Come play.

📍 Coro, Bengaluru
Walk-ins welcome / DM us to find out more.
